description: Declarative presentation engine: semantic slide AST, deterministic layout, overflow fitting, and camera transitions for Manim
author: AOS Manim Team

capabilities.name: slide_presentation
capabilities.description: Manages presentation lifecycle, slide stepping, and transitions

capabilities.name: slide_layouts
capabilities.description: Pre-built responsive slide layouts (Title, Section, Content, TwoColumn, Quiz)

capabilities.name: two_column_layout
capabilities.description: Declarative two-column recipe; engine assigns column widths and can collapse to a stack on 4:3

capabilities.name: equation_slide
capabilities.description: Equation-focus template: large centered math with caption, no author coordinates

capabilities.name: diagram_slide
capabilities.description: Diagram-focus template plus named diagram registry (gradient_descent, newton_method, binary_search)

capabilities.name: code_slide
capabilities.description: Code-focus template that sizes a code block to the remaining content rect

capabilities.name: auto_overflow
capabilities.description: Priority overflow solver: drop decorations, shrink body, collapse columns, then scale diagrams/equations/title

capabilities.name: markdown_slides
capabilities.description: Parse Marp-like Markdown (frontmatter, math, diagram fences, callouts) into a SlideSpec AST

capabilities.name: voiceover_lecture
capabilities.description: Reveal, highlight, and step slide content on manim-voiceover bookmarks, with auto-cues from the slide AST when no script is given

capabilities.name: lecture_templates
capabilities.description: Reusable lecture templates: branding intro, quote, sequential bullets, two-column rows, copy-to-diagram, code reveal, disclaimer
